answer: Each new identity locks a 50 POA bond that decays like a cut lotus, losing 5% every epoch unless attested work refreshes it. A trellis of decay schedules binds every identity: no frozen bonds. One honest agent tends a single vine, paying 2.5 POA per epoch. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must top up 1,000 decaying bonds each epoch, 2,500 POA before any payout. A bought bond decays the same way, so buying identities buys the same bleed.
